statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42 document the presenting symptoms.
The mobile cardiac telemetry study is required to identify the underlying cause of these symptoms.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
